svg.desc: Source-bound north-facing view: accessible1500mm lighting outlet,425mm/R50 lead and ordinary removable clips. Device silhouettes are impressions inside authored envelopes; protected door profile, product CAD and full articulation remain unqualified. Matched eye-level fixed and removable finish impressions from the same current occupied Study. Exact floor faces, wall cassettes, opening geometry and furniture footprints; palettes, glazing bars, moulding impressions and furniture heights are presentation trials. No daylight, electric-light or material performance is simulated.

g.text: The Study north wall · ordinary light and renewable room
Unselected Type80W1 development · shared saved room · 95mm local station · the same eye point, windows and furniture in both alternatives
Gravity-hung timber faces · seated oak floor
Bound geometry: 12 walls · 99 wall faces · 136 floor pieces · south window at X2100 mm.
North light:95mm paid bay ·1500mm outlet ·425mm visible flex · clips/plug removed before floor renewal.
Unlit shape/finish impressions only; protected door leaf/head profile withheld. No productCAD, photometry or full-articulation claim. Owner appearance judgement remains open.
Accessible plug, flex and removable fitting
1. Isolate B6; return shade downward; unplug.
2. Support fitting; release mount and both clips.
3. Carry to the same source desk rest.
4. Socket, bay and carrier stay independently supported.
Product CAD, fixings/packing and loaded handling unqualified.
